frame.note: Same frame as map/research-techno-plaza.json: x = metres east, y = metres north of geo_origin (SW corner of the building outline's bounding box). All levels share one canvas.
frame.svg: 1 SVG user unit = 1 metre; svg_x = x, svg_y = -y (north is up on the page).
frame.png: px = origin_px[0] + x * pixels_per_metre; py = origin_px[1] - y * pixels_per_metre
